Hi,

Thanks for letting me know, and glad you're staying with us. Nothing further is needed from you. We'll keep you posted by email as your order moves, and the tracking details come to this same address as soon as it ships.

If anything else comes up in the meantime, just reply here and I'll pick it up.

If you were happy with how this was handled, a short review would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also very welcome in our community: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
